text_block_list.text:
The final big showdown of the Senior 
Year... the Arima Kinen. The day of the 
race has arrived.

The timid girl she once was is nowhere to 
be found. In order to shine brighter than 
anyone else—

She took a step forward toward the Arima 
Kinen, where formidable champions, 
including Tokai Teio, awaited.
